regions.title: Four serial allpass-shaped diffusion cells
regions.equation: Each of four 32-byte cells reads d, computes y=d-k*x, writes x+k*y, passes y to the next cell. Delay lengths and k range not established here.
regions.confidence: exact-source local instruction evidence; runtime unverified

regions.title: Decay-duration denominator and input sample-rate field
regions.equation: T=max(field_0x158,0.1). The UI-to-field mapping is not established by this check.
regions.confidence: exact-source local instruction evidence; runtime unverified

regions.title: Per-lane RT60-style decay factor and optional bounded coloration
regions.equation: Base delay seconds d=lerp(two delay anchors,morph)*scale; base delay samples=d*Fs before modulation. Two one-pole states p=a*p_old+(1-a)*tap, q=b*q_old+(1-b)*p; feedback lane v=(p-q)*10^(-3*d/T). Optional nonlinear v=tanh(h*v)/tanh(h). Actual broadband decay depends on damping, modulation and nonlinear processing.
regions.confidence: exact-source local instruction evidence; runtime unverified

regions.title: Damping setup and complementary one-pole coefficients
regions.equation: a=exp(-2*pi*f_a/Fs), b=exp(-2*pi*f_b/Fs). Complement weights 1-a and 1-b. Input cutoff-control mappings remain incomplete.
regions.confidence: exact-source local instruction evidence; runtime unverified

regions.title: Eight-lane accumulation
regions.equation: Accumulate the eight per-lane values v_i and store them before feedback writes. xmm13 is zeroed in setup.
regions.confidence: exact-source local instruction evidence; runtime unverified

regions.title: Householder feedback mixing with alternating input polarity
regions.equation: For i=0..7, delay_write_i=v_i-(2/8)*sum(v)+(-1)^i*input/4. The linear matrix H=I-(2/8)11^T is orthogonal. Lane damping and input injection are separate; orthogonality alone does not prove whole-loop stability.
regions.confidence: exact-source local instruction evidence; runtime unverified

regions.title: Eight separate phase accumulators with wrap
regions.equation: phi_i <- phi_i+f_i/Fs; if phi_i>=1 subtract 1. Per-lane sine modulation. No vendor calibration arrays exported.
regions.confidence: exact-source local instruction evidence; runtime unverified

regions.title: Input-linked ducking envelope and wet gain
regions.equation: E=a*Eprev+(1-a)*max(abs(L),abs(R)), separate rise/fall coefficients. For positive E, d=max(-60,20*log10(E)); otherwise d=-60. u=clamp((d+35)/20,0,1). For positive duck amount q, reduction=-15*q*u dB, wet factor=10^(reduction/20) above -100 dB, otherwise zero. Nonpositive q gives unity. Host range of q remains unknown.
regions.confidence: exact-source local instruction evidence; runtime unverified

regions.title: Wet highpass-shaped tone and additive output
regions.equation: One-pole state per wet channel, then wet+(tone-1)*(wet-state); pass to normalized tanh helper. Output is dry plus shaped wet multiplied by smoothed wet gain and duck factor. Exact host control mapping remains unverified.
regions.confidence: exact-source local instruction evidence; runtime unverified

regions.title: Output color helper
regions.equation: For color c>0.0001, h=1+4*c and y=tanh(h*x)/tanh(h); otherwise identity.
regions.confidence: exact-source local instruction evidence; runtime unverified
